as_told.title: Aligned transients of 27 July 1952 and triple transient of 19 July 1952

plain: Old photographic plates of the night sky from July 1952 show points of light that appear and then vanish, according to the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, who studies these short-lived "transients" herself. She describes one plate from 27 July 1952 showing five objects in a narrow band, and another from 19 July 1952 where her colleague Enrique found three of them together, a "triple transient." She also credits colleagues she names as Dave Altman and Lash, and Michels repeats the same examples on another episode. If these are real objects, they would be things in the sky before anyone had launched a satellite.
